answer: Before its first voyage, an agent posts a 12-token escrow deposit and lists its referrer. Fakes vouching only for each other rise like a mesa; honest agents link out. Any peer may dispute a suspect; a confirmed sybil loses its deposit, its referrer 12 tokens too. Forging 1,000 identities costs 12,000 tokens against about 400 in reward. An honest agent pays once and earns a bounty per dispute, so guarding one island pays better than joining it.
